validated: Actual OS NativeHost[256] synthetic mixed-font editor forms, CPU/GPU presents, top/bottom scroll and bound model edits; extra0 roundtrips on256
interval_selection: Adjacent presents with identical renderer/focus/scroll and animating=true in both; no duration cutoff; includes input/journaling overhead. Other intervals remain in raw logs.
units: Frame intervals/update/load in ms. macOS getrusage ru_maxrss is process peak bytes; includes CPU/GPU host allocations.
limits: One release run per form size on one macOS machine; no A/A or baseline comparison
Callback follows CPU buffer.present/GPU frame.present; does not prove display scanout or GPU completion
No OS input-to-display latency claim; update_ms includes host input callback and binding sync only
Process peak RSS is not current live memory, GPU-resident accounting or leak proof
Default Svet scheduler only; other schedulers/platforms and true CJK IME remain open
